model_annotation: Figure 3 presents a pie chart illustrating responses to survey question B4 regarding the degree of agreement with the statement “Design is well integrated into the product development process in our organization.” The chart is divided into five colored segments, each corresponding to a response category as indicated by the legend: blue for “It is integrated” (10 respondents), orange for “Well integrated” (24 respondents), green for “Good integrated” (25 respondents), red for “Poorly integrated” (8 respondents), and purple for “It is not integrated as such an approach” (20 respondents). The segments are arranged in a circular layout, with no apparent ordering by size or other visual hierarchy. The legend is positioned to the left of the chart and clearly associates each color with its respective response category and numerical count. The chart does not include percentage labels within the segments, nor are any segments visually emphasized through size, shape, or color differentiation beyond the standard pie chart representation.
